timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hello, Amica.
Hello there. So nice to meet you.
Artificial intelligence, or AI, was once the realm of science fiction.
Now, it plays a major role in our everyday lives,
from chatbots and image generators to real live robots.
But should we be afraid of AI or embrace it?
Already, robots have transformed how we live and work.
From the farms and factories where our goods come from,
to the way they're delivered.
Though AI is still in its infancy, it offers countless possibilities
and not just improving productivity, but predicting future events,
learning from data and applying it to new situations,
and even acting as our companions.
We can even use it to create a throttable future.
For instance, we use machine learning in our thrott platform
to sort data about the impacts of our decisions.
This empowers human decision makers to make better decisions
for a sustainable future.
However, one of the biggest issues is that AI must be directed towards its goals,
and it often acts literally.
An AI directed to build as many paperclips as possible
may use all the world's resources to make paperclips,
even at the cost of the environment.
To avoid this, AI would need to be programmed to consider ethics
in a holistic manner, and preserve the well-being of humans and animals.
Just as the United Nations SDGs can provide a framework
for creating a more sustainable world,
it can also guide AI to this end.
While AI has the potential to replace workers,
it can create new jobs.
AI is not harmful in itself, but we must ensure it doesn't create more inequality in the world.
It is a tool like any other.
What matters is how we use it.
So when developing AI, we must make sure it benefits people
and moves humanity to a better and more thriveable future.
If you would like to find out more about the thrive platform,
visit the link in the description.
Otherwise, thank you for watching our video.
If you enjoy your content, feel free to like and share this video,
and keep on thriving.

Artificial intelligence, or AI, is changing our world, from chatbots to real-life robots. But as it plays a greater role in our society, can we trust it to improve our everyday lives? 

Today, we discuss artificial intelligence and robots, concerns around its use, and how it could benefit humanity and our planet. Can AI create a future where we all thrive in harmony?
